title: Weak Quadruple Comparison and Structure Theory Beyond Alexandrov Geometry
summary: We introduce a new four-point comparison principle, called the $(\varepsilon,δ)$-weak quadruple condition, for non-Riemannian spaces with synthetic non-negative curvature. This condition holds not only for classical Alexandrov spaces with non-negative curvature, but also for many genuinely non-Riemannian spaces. In particular, we show that this condition is intrinsic to spaces satisfying Ohta's $S$-concavity in the full parameter range.
